gui.blackbox.handbook.title: Blackbox Handbook
gui.blackbox.handbook.subtitle: Farm Manual
gui.blackbox.handbook.section.start.tool: Understand the core and prepare a farm
gui.blackbox.handbook.section.simulate.t: Use a recorded core in a Blackbox
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.0.title: Blackbox in One Minute
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.0.body: Build a farm once, record its net production, then run that saved profile from one compact Blackbox. The farm cell stays unloaded while the Blackbox produces its measured result.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.0.tip: Only the cell's net change is saved. Moving stored items around cannot create free resources.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.1.title: Prepare a Dimension Core
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.1.body: Insert an empty Dimension Core into a Blackbox, give the farm a name, and choose access. Apply cell size, environment, and mob-spawn upgrades at an Anvil before entering the cell for the first time.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.1.tip: Core colours identify the selected environment: yellow, green, red, or purple.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.2.title: Build the Farm
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.2.body: Use Enter Farm to open the core's private cell. It has a Dimensional Bedrock floor, one Farm Input, and one Farm Output. Build only inside the barrier; a Farm Actor is active while building or measuring.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.2.tip: The minecart mark on a Farm Input is its front. Vehicles arrive one block in front of it.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.3.title: Connect the Ports
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.3.body: The blue Farm Input accepts items, fluids, and FE from the Blackbox. The green Farm Output returns them. Use one Input and as many Outputs as the farm needs; all Outputs are recorded together.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.3.tip: You may manually take building materials from a Farm Output while inside the cell.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.4.title: Record Production
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.4.body: When the farm is ready, leave through Dimensional Bedrock. A private preparation phase runs first, then the server records the configured window. Farm chunks tick during recording and results survive restarts.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.4.tip: Re-entering a cell cancels its active recording so you can edit and measure it again.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.5.title: Read the Farm Profile
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.5.body: Hold Shift over a programmed core to see item, fluid, FE, and mob requirements per minute. The profile measures inventories, tanks, energy stores, ports, and persistent mobs as one net balance.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.5.tip: A full Blackbox never stops a recording: pending output is held in a persistent buffer.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.6.title: Run a Blackbox
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.6.body: Insert a programmed core and the Blackbox starts automatically. It draws items, fluids, and FE gradually as the profile runs. Configure every side for item, fluid, FE, both, or disabled in Side Routing.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.6.tip: A 500 kFE tank can run a larger profile when it receives power while operating.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.7.title: Control What Comes Out
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.7.body: Without Stability, the Blackbox replays measured peaks and quiet periods. Stability smooths output. An Output Filter lets this one Blackbox discard selected items while inputs are still consumed normally.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.7.tip: Filter choices belong to the upgrade, so the same core can produce everything elsewhere.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.8.title: Mobs, Blueprints, and Admin
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.8.body: Persistent mobs lost by a farm become inputs; natural and active-spawner mobs do not. Drive an occupied boat or minecart into a Blackbox to move needed mobs into the cell. Right-click a Blueprint to open its library.
gui.blackbox.handbook.page.8.tip: Operators use the Admin Book for blocked blocks, farm cells, and future measurement duration.
